prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1109
Claimant:
John Butler
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
4 Jan 2025
The claimant reported a rear-end collision at a low-speed intersection and said their neck and upper back hurt
immediately afterward. The reported injury fits the kind and force of this impact well, and the claimant is not
represented by an attorney.
5 Jan 2025
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and was covered at the time of loss.
Nothing suggests the damage occurred before the coverage period started.
19 Jan 2025
Spoke with the claimant by phone to take a recorded statement. The account of how the collision happened was
consistent with what was first reported.
3 Feb 2025
Received photos from the claimant showing rear bumper and trunk damage. The photos confirm some details of the
impact, and the vehicle damage matches the described collision.
29 Mar 2025
Requested the police report, which confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. Attempted to locate
independent witnesses, but none have come forward and no third-party accounts are available.
6 May 2025
Ran a prior claims and medical history search. No earlier injury to the neck or upper back has been found, and no
earlier damage to the vehicle is on record.
8 May 2025
Authorized an independent vehicle inspection. The inspector's estimate lines up with the damage pattern shown in
the photos and with the reported point of impact.
16 May 2025
Called the claimant for a follow-up. They repeated the same account of the collision that was gievn in the first report
and the recorded statement, with no changes in the sequence of events.
17 May 2025
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this type of injury. Requested treatment records and
itemized bills from the provider to review the care plan against standard guidelines.
28 May 2025
Reviewed the file with the claims supervisor. Coverage is confirmed, the injury and vehicle damage are consistent
with the collision, and the claim will proceed to evaluation of the medical records and the length of treatment.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
